messages:
Maya: Quick sync — postmortem is up: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-regional-failover
Maya: TL;DR: primary cause was multi-region routing mismatch + delayed failover in Dedicated pools. We have a list of follow-ups in the doc but need concrete owners/dates.
Jordan: volunteering to own multi-region routing automation + rollout policy. I'll link a ticket: INF-12345. Targeting a patch by 2026-04-10 for policy + canary.
Eli: I'll take backups + restore runbook updates. I'll run a validation sweep on DB snapshots and object-store restore paths.
Eli: quick checklist I'll follow:
```
- verify snapshot retention (7/30/90)
- restore smoke test to staging
- validate KMS key access in region failover
- document RTO/RPO expectations
```
Samira: I'll organize a DR game day. Proposing 2026-04-17 09:00 PT. Agenda: runbook dry-run, traffic-shift, restore-from-snapshot, telemetry verification. :calendar: 
Maya: OpsBot, tag postmortem follow-ups with "DR-Failover" label
OpsBot: [automated] postmortem doc updated — labels: DR-Failover, P1-Mitigations
Jordan: Noticed recurring pattern: abrupt BGP route flaps during provider maintenance => traffic shift spikes. Suggest adding a gradual-weight routing policy and shorter health-check grace window.
Jordan: config proto (sketch):
```
route-policy:
  prefer-primary: true
  failover-weight-step: 10  # percent per 30s
  health-check-grace: 15s
```
Eli: I'll also add a step in the runbook to verify KV cache warming after route changes — avoids cold-token spikes.
Samira: For game day, I need two folks for the war room (monitoring + rollback). @Jordan @Eli can you confirm availability?
Jordan: I can do monitoring. I'll wire dashboards: latency by region, redis hit-rate, request-fanout.
Eli: I'll be on rollback/runbook actions. Confirmed.
Maya: Cool — action list (adding owners + deadlines):
- INF-12345 Jordan — routing policy automation — due 2026-04-10
- RB-6789 Eli — restore runbook + backup validation — due 2026-04-08
- GD-4321 Samira — schedule/ops for DR game day (2026-04-17) — due 2026-04-03
Maya: Please add these to the follow-ups sheet and attach any PR/ticket links. I'll track progress in the postmortem doc.
Samira: Putting event on #calendar and invite to oncall + svc-eng leads. Will include playbook link.
Eli: Created PR #204 for runbook edits: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/204 — contains restore steps and KV-cache note.
Jordan: INF-12345 created and assigned. Added canary plan and rollback commands to the ticket.
Maya: Good. Small ask: include test signal sets (prompt sets, synthetic traffic) for quality monitoring post-failover — Redwood-Optimize team wants baseline curves.
Jordan: Will export synthetic traffic harness and add to INF-12345. Good call.
OpsBot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window conflict check completed — no conflicts on 2026-04-17.
Samira: Ok team — if no objections I'll lock game day and start invites. Any blockers?
Eli: none from DB side. I'll finish validation by due date.
Jordan: none. I'll queue the canary and schedule a dry-run in staging.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll follow up next week with a short status update. React with :white_check_mark: when you've added tickets/PRs to the sheet.
Jordan: ✅ added INF-12345 to sheet
Eli: ✅ PR linked and RB-6789 created
Samira: ✅ calendar invite sent to leads
Maya: great, closing this thread — will reopen if anything slips. :handshake:
